title: MCP Server
description: Connect AI agents to this project over the Model Context Protocol. An agent sees what its API key allows.
offForTeam: MCP is off for the team {team}.
offForProject: The team {team} has MCP on, but this project is off.
askManager: Ask a team owner or manager to turn it on:
keyHint: Create a key on the API keys page, then replace {apiKey} in the snippet.

notes.claudeDesktop: Claude Desktop connects to remote servers through the mcp-remote bridge. Needs Node.js.
notes.other: Any client that supports MCP over Streamable HTTP works. Point it at the endpoint. Send an Authorization: Bearer {apiKey} header.

oauth.description: Use this for any MCP client that supports OAuth, such as ChatGPT or Claude. You sign in with your {app} account. The client never receives an API key.

steps.add: Add an MCP app in your client.
steps.choose: Choose OAuth when the client asks how to sign in.
steps.signIn: Sign in to {app} and approve access.

oauth.security: OAuth uses PKCE (S256), dynamic client registration, and access tokens scoped to your {app} account.

consent.title: Allow {client} to access your account?
consent.titleUnnamed: Allow an unnamed app to access your account?
consent.actsAs: Once allowed, the app acts as you:
consent.canSee: Sees everything you can see, in all your teams
consent.canChange: Creates, changes and deletes anything you can
consent.keepsAccess: Keeps access until you disconnect it in Account › Security
consent.named: The app named itself “{client}”. Allow only if you started this connection.
consent.unnamed: The app sent no name. Allow only if you started this connection.
consent.expired: This request expired after 10 minutes. Start the connection again in the app.
consent.failed: Your answer did not go through. Try again.
consent.incompleteBody: Start the connection again in the app.
consent.brandSubtitle: Connect AI apps such as Claude and ChatGPT to your account.
